dialogue.content: こんにちは。本日よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Hello. Thank you for your time today.

dialogue.content: こんにちは、よろしくお願いします！
dialogue.English: Hello, thank you! I'm ready when you are.

dialogue.content: 少し早いですが始めてもよろしいですか？
dialogue.English: It's a little early, but would it be alright if we begin?

dialogue.content: わかりました！はじめましょう
dialogue.English: Of course! Let's begin.

dialogue.content: お願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: お願いします
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: こんにちは。相談員です。始めに年齢と性別、そして何とお呼びしたら良いか教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: Hello. I'm your counselor. To begin, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you would like me to call you?

dialogue.content: 20代女です。あかりです。
dialogue.English: I'm a woman in my 20s. My name is Akari.

dialogue.content: あかりさんですね。ありがとうございます。本日はどのようなご相談ですか？
dialogue.English: Akari, is that right? Thank you. What brings you here to talk about today?

dialogue.content: 何もする気が起きない
dialogue.English: I don't feel like doing anything.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。そんな時ってありますよね。
dialogue.English: I see. It's normal to feel that way sometimes.

dialogue.content: ずっとです
dialogue.English: It's been like this for a long time.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。ずっと続いてしまうと辛いですよね。もう少し具体的に教えていただいてもよろしいですか？
dialogue.English: I understand. It must be difficult when it continues for so long. Could you tell me a little more about it?

dialogue.content: 毎日ただ起きて何となくご飯食べてテレビ見ての繰り返し
dialogue.English: Every day is the same thing on repeat: just waking up, eating something without really thinking about it, and watching TV.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: すぐ寝たくなるし
dialogue.English: And I feel like going to sleep right away.

dialogue.content: ええ。
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: 仕事つかなきゃとは思うんだけど
dialogue.English: I keep thinking I should get a job, but...

dialogue.content: ええ。
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: こわくてそのまんま
dialogue.English: I'm scared, so I'm just stuck.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: だからずっと同じことの繰り返し
dialogue.English: That's why I'm stuck in the same routine, over and over.

dialogue.content: 不安なお気持ちだったのですね。よくご相談してくださいましたね。今日は不安や怖い思いを全て吐き出してくださいね。
dialogue.English: You must have been feeling so anxious. Thank you for reaching out to talk about it. Please feel free to let out all of your worries and fears today.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 例えば、どんなところが怖くなってしまわれるのですか？
dialogue.English: For example, what kinds of things tend to feel scary?

dialogue.content: 再就職先でまた怒鳴られまくったら嫌だなって
dialogue.English: I'm just worried that I'll get yelled at constantly again at a new job.

dialogue.content: なるほどですね。怒鳴られて怖かった思いをされたのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. You had a scary experience of being yelled at.

dialogue.content: そうなんです
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: それは不安や怖さに繋がってしまいますよね。
dialogue.English: That would certainly lead to anxiety and fear.

dialogue.content: 理不尽なかた多いですよね。
dialogue.English: There are a lot of unreasonable people out there, aren't there?

dialogue.content: 特に、
dialogue.English: Especially...

dialogue.content: 上司が毎日理由なく怒鳴る人でした
dialogue.English: My boss was the kind of person who would yell every day for no reason.

dialogue.content: 同僚もみんな辞めてくし
dialogue.English: All my coworkers kept quitting, too.

dialogue.content: 仕事になると「仕事なのだから当たり前だ」みたいな感じでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Was it a situation where the attitude was, "It's work, so of course it's going to be like this"?

dialogue.content: 同僚がやめて行ったら辛いですよね
dialogue.English: It must be hard when your colleagues quit, isn't it?

dialogue.content: 仕事だから当たり前みたいな、まじめな理由でもなかったです
dialogue.English: It wasn't even for a serious reason, like "it's just part of the job."

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。例えばどんなことがありましたか？
dialogue.English: I see. For example, what kinds of things happened?

dialogue.content: 奥さんとケンカしたから機嫌悪く、電話の取り継ぎ方が気に入らないとか
dialogue.English: For instance, he'd be in a bad mood because he'd fought with his wife, and then he'd complain that he didn't like the way I transferred a call.

dialogue.content: ええ。
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: 書類の渡し方が気に入らないとか
dialogue.English: Or that he didn't like the way I handed him documents.

dialogue.content: それは理不尽ですね。
dialogue.English: That's completely unreasonable.

dialogue.content: そうなんですよ！
dialogue.English: Exactly!

dialogue.content: わかりますね。私もそのような人に会ったことありますので。辛いですよね。
dialogue.English: I understand completely. I've met people like that too. It's tough, isn't it?

dialogue.content: 自分に非がなく怒られるのってこんなにメンタルにくるとは思いませんでした
dialogue.English: I never realized how hard it would hit my mental health to be yelled at when it's not my fault.

dialogue.content: だってなおせないんですもん
dialogue.English: Because there's nothing I can do to fix it.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。あかりさんが悪いとは一ミリも思いません。
dialogue.English: That's right. I don't think you were at fault in the slightest, Akari.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 現在は退職されているのですか？
dialogue.English: So have you left that job now?

dialogue.content: はい仕事してないです
dialogue.English: Yes, I'm not working right now.

dialogue.content: 仕事しなきゃと思うんです
dialogue.English: I feel like I need to get a job, though.

dialogue.content: なるほど。再就職先に同じような上司がいるかもしれないと考えると怖くなってしまうのですよね？
dialogue.English: I see. So it's the thought that you might have a similar boss at your next job that makes you feel scared, right?

dialogue.content: そうです
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: そう思うと進めないんです
dialogue.English: When I think about that, I can't move forward.

dialogue.content: 確かに仕事をしないと焦りますよね。金銭面でもそうですし、
dialogue.English: It's true that not having a job can make you feel anxious, both financially and in other ways.

dialogue.content: またそのような上司がいると思うと進めなくなるお気持ちすごくわかります。
dialogue.English: I can really understand how the thought of having another boss like that would make you feel stuck.

dialogue.content: 金銭面も不安ですけど、履歴の期間の空白が嫌だなって
dialogue.English: I'm anxious about money, but I also hate the idea of having a gap in my work history.

dialogue.content: 絶対聞かれるじゃない？前の仕事辞めてから何してたのって
dialogue.English: They'll definitely ask, won't they? "So, what have you been doing since you left your last job?"

dialogue.content: そう思われるのも無理もありませんよね。確かに聞かれるかもしれません。
dialogue.English: It's completely understandable that you'd think that. And you might indeed be asked about it.

dialogue.content: でも、
dialogue.English: But...

dialogue.content: 焦らず解決策を一緒に探していきましょうね。
dialogue.English: let's take our time and look for a solution together.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 私のお話をしてもよろしいですか？
dialogue.English: Would it be alright if I shared a bit of my own experience?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 私も以前の職場で辛い体験がありました。上司が仕事中に俺の車を洗えと言ってきたんです。
dialogue.English: I also had a difficult experience at a previous job. My boss told me to wash his car during work hours.

dialogue.content: えー！
dialogue.English: What?!

dialogue.content: そんなこと言われたんですか？！
dialogue.English: He really said that to you?!

dialogue.content: 理由は、鳥のふんがついたから。もう、すぐにやめてしまいました笑
dialogue.English: The reason? A bird had pooped on it. I quit right away, haha.

dialogue.content: 自分で取れよ😥辞めますよね
dialogue.English: He should have cleaned it himself! 😥 Of course you'd quit after that.

dialogue.content: ええ。こんな上司なんていやだ〜って感じでした。
dialogue.English: Exactly. I was just thinking, "I can't stand having a boss like this."

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Uh-huh, uh-huh.

dialogue.content: いやですよ
dialogue.English: That's awful.

dialogue.content: なかなか前に進めなかった時期があったのですが、
dialogue.English: There was a time when I had trouble moving forward, but...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 相談した人に「それはなかなか面白いね」なんて言われて、
dialogue.English: someone I talked to about it told me, "Wow, that's a pretty interesting story,"

dialogue.content: えー？笑
dialogue.English: Huh? Haha.

dialogue.content: 自分で考え方を変えてみました。「世の中いろんな人がいるよな」って。そしたら少し前進できました。
dialogue.English: so I tried to change my own perspective. I started thinking, "Well, it takes all kinds to make a world." And then I was able to move forward a little.

dialogue.content: あかりさんはこの考え方どう思われますか？
dialogue.English: What do you think of that way of looking at it, Akari?

dialogue.content: 世の中いろんな人がいるかー
dialogue.English: "There are all kinds of people in the world," huh...

dialogue.content: たしかに嫌な人ばかりではないですもんね
dialogue.English: That's true, not everyone out there is an unpleasant person.

dialogue.content: はい。いろんな人がいますよね。笑
dialogue.English: Yes. There are all sorts of people, aren't there? Haha.

dialogue.content: 考え方を変えて見るというのもいい方法だと思いまして、
dialogue.English: I thought that reframing your perspective might be a good approach,

dialogue.content: そうですね、そう言われるとそれがあまり前のことなのに
dialogue.English: You're right. Now that you say it, I realize that even though that was in the past,

dialogue.content: 一つ提案させていただきました。
dialogue.English: so I wanted to suggest it as one idea.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: なんか嫌な人にぶち当たることばかり考えてたかも
dialogue.English: I guess I might have only been thinking about the possibility of running into another unpleasant person.

dialogue.content: おお。素晴らしい気付きですね。
dialogue.English: Oh, that's a wonderful realization.

dialogue.content: あかりさんは仕事はしたいけど、
dialogue.English: You want to work, Akari, but...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: その不安で前に進めないわけですから、
dialogue.English: it's that anxiety that's keeping you from moving forward,

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: その不安（考え方）がなくなれば前進していけるのではと思います。
dialogue.English: I believe that if that anxiety—that way of thinking—were to ease, you would be able to move forward.

dialogue.content: あと、
dialogue.English: Also,

dialogue.content: 前進だけでなく、今のように立ち止まって考えているあかりさんは自分と向き合っているのでそれだけでも成長に繋がっているのではと思います。
dialogue.English: it's not just about moving forward. The very fact that you're pausing to reflect like this means you're confronting yourself, and I believe that in itself is a connection to growth.

dialogue.content: そうなのかな停滞してるだけだと思ってた
dialogue.English: Is that so? I just thought I was stagnating.

dialogue.content: そんなことありませんよ。しっかり自分と向き合えているからこそ悩みが出てくるわけですからね。
dialogue.English: Not at all. These worries are coming up precisely because you're truly facing yourself.

dialogue.content: そうかー
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: 絶対そうですよ。そのくらい自分と向き合っているあかりさんは良い職場、良い仲間に出会えるのではないかと思います。
dialogue.English: Absolutely. I believe that because you're taking the time to face yourself like this, you'll be able to find a good workplace and good colleagues.

dialogue.content: なんか不安でこわくて逃げてただけなんですけどね😅
dialogue.English: I feel like I was just running away because I was anxious and scared, though. 😅

dialogue.content: まあ、そんな時もありますよね。人ですもの😃
dialogue.English: Well, we all have times like that. We're only human, after all. 😃

dialogue.content: そんなものですかね
dialogue.English: I guess so, huh?

dialogue.content: そういうことも起こり得ますよね。でもあかりさんの自己探求力であれば乗り越えていけるのではと思いますよ。
dialogue.English: Things like that can happen. But with your capacity for self-reflection, I believe you can overcome this.

dialogue.content: 面接で怒鳴る人だったらどうしよう…
dialogue.English: What if the interviewer is someone who yells...

dialogue.content: 面接では怒鳴られないか😥
dialogue.English: Oh, wait, they probably wouldn't yell during the interview itself. 😥

dialogue.content: 入ってからだよなー
dialogue.English: That's something that would happen after I get hired, right?

dialogue.content: 不安に思うかもしれませんが、「圧迫面接だ」と考え方を変えて見るのはどうでしょう？まあ面接で怒鳴るのはなかなかないかもですが。
dialogue.English: You may feel anxious, but how about reframing it as a "stress interview"? Though, it's pretty unlikely that someone would actually yell during an interview.

dialogue.content: 圧迫面接かーそれはありえそう
dialogue.English: A stress interview, huh... Yeah, that seems possible.

dialogue.content: そうですよね面接で怒鳴るところはそのままやめればいいんだ笑
dialogue.English: You're right. If a place is the kind that yells during an interview, I can just decide not to work there, haha.

dialogue.content: そうです。そうです。選択肢はあかりさんにありますからね！
dialogue.English: Exactly, exactly! The choice is yours, Akari!

dialogue.content: 選択肢は私にあるのか
dialogue.English: The choice is mine, huh...

dialogue.content: いやなところからは離れれば良いんですよ。我慢して体調を壊しては本末転倒ですからね。
dialogue.English: You can just leave a place that feels wrong. It's counterproductive to force yourself to endure it and end up harming your health.

dialogue.content: それはそうですね…胃炎起こしましたもの
dialogue.English: That's true... I even developed gastritis from the stress.

dialogue.content: それはお辛かったですね。自分に合った職場を見つけていければ良いですよね。働きがいも上がるのではと思います。
dialogue.English: That must have been so difficult. It would be great if you could find a workplace that's a good fit for you. I think it would make your work feel much more rewarding, too.

dialogue.content: 不安な時は、
dialogue.English: When you feel anxious,

dialogue.content: 考え方を変えて見るというのと、また相談していただければと思います。
dialogue.English: I hope you'll try reframing your perspective, and also feel free to reach out to talk again.

dialogue.content: はい、やってみます
dialogue.English: Okay, I'll give it a try.

dialogue.content: あかりさんの成長、成功を願っています。今日相談されてみていかがでしたか？
dialogue.English: I'm wishing you all the best in your growth and success, Akari. How do you feel after talking today?

dialogue.content: いろんな人がいると思えばこわい未来だけじゃないのかも？と少し思えるかな
dialogue.English: If I try to remember that there are all kinds of people out there, maybe I can start to think the future isn't only scary.

dialogue.content: まだできるかはわからないけど
dialogue.English: I'm not sure if I can actually do it yet, though.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。微力ながら、あかりさんのためになれれば幸いです。
dialogue.English: I'm glad to hear that. I'm happy if I was able to be of some help to you, Akari.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: こちらこそ相談いただきありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you as well for reaching out and talking with me.

dialogue.content: ロールプレイを終了してもよろしいですか？
dialogue.English: Is it alright if we end the role-play now?

dialogue.content: はーい🙋‍♀️
dialogue.English: Okay! 🙋‍♀️

dialogue.content: それではお疲れ様でした。失礼いたしますね。
dialogue.English: Alright then, thank you for your time and effort today. Goodbye.
